Zapata Quantum and QuEra Systems have announced a partnership focused on accelerating commercial quantum applications for Amazon Web Services, targeting AWS’s planned MegaQuop quantum supercomputer expected to launch in 2028. The collaboration combines Zapata’s algorithmic software expertise with QuEra’s photonic processor technology to develop optimized quantum workloads for the forthcoming large‑scale AWS infrastructure. This initiative is part of a broader industry push to move practical quantum computing from research labs into commercial deployment by 2030.
